# Anode

> The 4-Pillar Proof-of-Topology Bare-Metal Orchestrator for Unmodified Go Backends.

Anode compiles Go Single Static Assignment (SSA) call graphs directly into bare-metal Linux systemd units, cgroups v2 resource limits, dynamic loopback proxies, and automated Caddy reverse proxy configurations with 8ms cold starts and 4.8MB RAM footprint. Zero Docker, zero Kubernetes.

## Core Pillars
- **Zero-Declaration Topology**: Infers services, ports, database drivers, and egress targets via whole-program SSA and Variable Type Analysis (VTA) in milliseconds without YAML.
- **Ephemeral Dynamic Loopback**: Eliminates port collisions (5432, 6379, 8080) by dynamically proxying loopback addresses during local development without touching host ports.
- **Bare-Metal Linux Isolation**: Direct execution on Linux VPS via hardened systemd units (`DynamicUser=yes`, `ProtectSystem=strict`) and auto-provisioned Caddy v2 TLS reverse proxies.
- **Deterministic Architecture Contract**: Generates immutable, cryptographically verifiable `anode.lock.json` manifests ensuring code and infrastructure never drift.

## Quickstart & Installation
- Official Homebrew Tap (macOS & Linux):
  `brew install abhiudayg/tap/anode`
- Standalone Automated Binary Installer:
  `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abhiudayg/anode/master/install.sh | bash`
- Go Toolchain Installer:
  `go install github.com/abhiudayg/anode/cmd/anode@latest`

## Core Commands
- `anode inspect [PATH]`: Extract whole-program SSA topology and write `anode.lock.json`
- `anode dev [PATH]`: Start local hot-reload daemon with dynamic loopback ports
- `anode deploy TARGET [PATH]`: Deploy release to bare-metal Linux host via systemd & Caddy (Docker parity alias: `anode run`)
- `anode cluster`: Inspect multi-node placement pools, memory bin-packing, and zero-trust firewalls
- `anode catalog`: Inspect pluggable stateful catalog drivers (Postgres, Redis, ClickHouse, MySQL, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, MinIO)

## Empirical Benchmarks
- Cold-boot startup: 8ms (vs 1,420ms container engine initialization, 177x faster)
- Process memory overhead: 4.8MB (vs 186MB containerd/dockerd baseline, 97% reduction)
- Static analysis sweep time: 62ms (baseline 2-service backend) to 799ms (32-service enterprise mesh)
- Local port collisions: 0% via dynamic loopback proxying
